summary: Brookfield Private Equity Fund LP filed a routine Form 8-K reporting unregistered sales of limited partnership units in its continuous private offering and updating Transactional NAV per unit as of August 31, 2026. On September 1, 2026, the Fund sold 69,477 Class S and 244,402 Class I units for roughly $8.76M; the broader BPE Program issued about $22.98M of interests. Since November 1, 2025, the Program has raised approximately $402.1M. NAVs: Class B-1 $28.58, B-2 $28.40, I $27.96, S $27.78. Sales were Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D exempt, with Class B-2 units sold to Brookfield affiliates and employees. Nothing here constitutes a special situation; it is ordinary private-placement capital formation.
